title: The markets no price feed reaches
summary: Of 68 national markets we tried to price, 16 have no live feed we could reach at any price — 95 listed companies with no quote available to a retail data buyer.

title: What the world's markets did — week to 24 August 2026
summary: 5 of 10 major markets rose over the week. Bovespa led at +3.52%; Nikkei 225 lagged at -3.40%.
